operations.body: At generic F_i=F_j with detH and F_iF_j nonzero, epsilon=y_i-y_j=(R_i-R_j)/(y_i+y_j) is a linear local parameter. operations.body: Entry 1227 resolves the generic F_i=F_j norm collision. On the labelled Kummer chart, q±=X±epsilon with epsilon=(R_i-R_j)/(y_i+y_j); det Jacobian=-2. The local Koszul/Cech object is regular, parameter monodromy is trivial, and only the existing anti-invariant top-intersection line remains. Next frontier is the non-generic corners F_i=F_j=0 and their intersections with detH=0, tested as derived branch/incidence tensors.
